a mighty blow: With a single mighty blow of his heavy axe, the woodcutter split the thick log in two.
樵夫用沉重的斧頭一記重擊，就把那根粗木頭劈成兩半。
a mighty empire: The Romans built a mighty empire that controlled much of Europe, North Africa, and the Middle East.
羅馬人建立了一個強大的帝國，統治了歐洲、北非和中東的大片地區。
high and mighty: Ever since she was chosen as class leader, she has acted high and mighty and refuses to sit with us.
自從她被選為班長後，她就表現得高傲自大，不肯跟我們坐在一起。
the mighty river: For thousands of years, people have farmed the rich land along the mighty river that flows through Egypt.
數千年來，人們一直在流經埃及的那條大河沿岸的肥沃土地上耕作。
mighty fine: "That's a mighty fine car you have there," the old farmer said, smiling as he touched the shiny paint.
「你那輛車真是非常好啊，」老農夫一邊笑著，一邊摸著閃亮的烤漆說。
a mild climate: Thanks to a mild climate with warm winters and cool summers, the island attracts tourists all year round.
多虧冬暖夏涼的溫和的氣候，這座島一年四季都吸引遊客。
a mild case of flu: The doctor said I only had a mild case of flu and would feel better after a few days of rest.
醫生說我只是得了輕微的流感，休息幾天就會好轉。
mild criticism: The teacher gave only mild criticism of my essay, gently suggesting that I check my spelling more carefully.
老師對我的作文只給了溫和的批評，委婉地建議我更仔細檢查拼字。
a mild cheese: Children who dislike strong flavors usually prefer a mild cheese that doesn't taste too sharp or salty.
不喜歡重口味的小孩通常偏好味道溫和的起司，吃起來不會太刺激或太鹹。
to put it mildly: The movie was boring, to put it mildly—half the audience fell asleep before the end.
說得客氣點，那部電影很無聊——一半的觀眾在結束前就睡著了。
mild surprise: She raised her eyebrows in mild surprise when her shy brother offered to sing at the party.
當她害羞的弟弟主動說要在派對上唱歌時，她揚起眉毛，露出微微的驚訝。
a miniature version: The museum shop sells a miniature version of Taipei 101 that is small enough to fit in your hand.
博物館商店販售台北101的縮小版，小到可以放在手掌上。
in miniature: This small park, with its tiny hills and lakes, shows the whole island's landscape in miniature.
這座小公園有小小的山丘和湖泊，以縮影的方式呈現了全島的地景。
a miniature railway: Children love riding the miniature railway in the zoo, whose little train is only as tall as an adult's knee.
孩子們喜歡搭動物園裡的迷你鐵道，那列小火車只有大人膝蓋那麼高。
a miniature painting: The artist spent three months on a miniature painting no bigger than a coin, using a brush with a single hair.
這位藝術家花了三個月完成一幅比硬幣還小的袖珍畫，用的是只有一根毛的畫筆。
minimal damage: Luckily, the typhoon caused only minimal damage to our house—just a few fallen leaves on the balcony.
幸運的是，颱風只對我們的房子造成極小的損害——陽台上只有幾片落葉而已。
with minimal effort: With this new app, you can make a weekly study plan with minimal effort in just a few clicks.
有了這個新應用程式，你只要點幾下就能幾乎不費力地做出每週讀書計畫。
minimal impact: The engineers designed the new road carefully so that it would have minimal impact on the forest and its wildlife.
工程師仔細設計新道路，使它對森林和野生動物只產生極小的影響。
at minimal cost: By using recycled materials, the students built a small greenhouse at minimal cost, spending less than five hundred dollars.
學生利用回收材料，以極低成本蓋了一座小溫室，花費不到五百元。
the minimum wage: The government plans to raise the minimum wage next year so that part-time workers can afford basic living costs.
政府計畫明年調高基本工資，讓兼職工作者負擔得起基本生活開銷。
a minimum of two years: Applicants for this job need a minimum of two years of work experience in sales or customer service.
應徵這份工作的人需要至少兩年的業務或客服工作經驗。
keep to a minimum: Please keep noise to a minimum in the library, because other students are trying to study.
請在圖書館把噪音減到最低，因為其他學生正在努力讀書。
minimum requirements: Before you buy the game, check whether your computer meets the minimum requirements listed on the box.
買這款遊戲之前，先確認你的電腦是否符合包裝盒上列出的最低要求。
a minus point: The hotel was clean and cheap; the only minus point was that it was far from the train station.
那間飯店乾淨又便宜；唯一的缺點是它離火車站很遠。
on the minus side: The apartment has a great view; on the minus side, it is small and there is no elevator.
這間公寓景觀很棒；但從不利的一面來看，它很小而且沒有電梯。
minus ten degrees: In winter the temperature in that northern city can drop to minus ten degrees, so pack a thick coat.
冬天時那座北方城市的氣溫可能降到零下十度，所以要帶件厚外套。
a B minus: I studied hard for the history test but only got a B minus, which was a little lower than I expected.
我為了歷史考試努力讀書，但只拿到 B 減，比我預期的低了一點。
a miserable failure: The school concert was a miserable failure: only ten people came, and the sound system kept breaking down.
那場學校音樂會徹底失敗：只來了十個人，而且音響系統一直故障。
miserable weather: We stayed indoors all weekend because of the miserable weather—it was cold, wet, and windy for three days.
因為糟透的天氣，我們整個週末都待在室內——連續三天又冷、又濕、又颳風。
a miserable salary: He works twelve hours a day for a miserable salary that barely pays for his rent and food.
他每天工作十二小時，卻只領少得可憐的薪水，勉強只夠付房租和伙食。
make life miserable for: The noisy construction next door made life miserable for everyone in our building for six months.
隔壁吵雜的施工讓我們大樓裡每個人的日子都不好過了半年。
feel miserable: After failing the test and arguing with my best friend, I felt miserable for the rest of the day.
考試不及格又和最好的朋友吵架後，那天接下來的時間我都感到痛苦悲慘。
